trigger: independent known-bad control using a synthetic incomplete CryptoMiniSat SAT model

finding.description: The parser returned source_model_valid=null for an incomplete SAT model, while the composition check accepted every value that was not false.
finding.impact: A truncated or missing model could pass the aggregate source-validation gate despite having no validated assignment. The archived real CMS models are complete; the defect is in fail-closed admission.

correction: Classify a SAT banner without a complete, source-valid model as sat_invalid_model.
Require source_model_valid is exactly true for every arm whose status is sat.
Retain timeout and Unknown as inconclusive rather than requiring a model.
scientific_inference: No archived cell changes because all admitted archived SAT models are complete and source-valid. Future and synthetic incomplete models now fail closed.
